verdict.rationale: Portkey is an AI gateway and LLMOps platform, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers routing, fallbacks, retries, caching, observability and budgets, but shows no user-defined scheduled or recurring jobs. The weekly budget-limit reset is a fixed system behavior, not a user-schedulable workflow, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
